Ashton Jeanty: The No. 6 overall draft pick played 71 percent of the snaps, his most
Ashton Jeanty had a 71% snap share against the Seahawks, his highest snap share since Week 3. He had a 15% target share — he's fallen below a 15% target share in just one game this year.

George Pickens saw a 37% target share in Week 10, which equaled 18 targets. That's 5 more targets than he's had in any other game of his career, and it was also his highest target share by about 2 percentage points.

With Brock Bowers off the field in Week 10, Jalen Nailor led the Raiders with a 91% route share. Tre Tucker was next at 83%, and then Michael Mayer and Jack Bech were at 77% and 71%, respectively. Jack Bech led all of them with a 30% target share.
